Keyframes define animation stages; animation properties control how the stages run.
@keyframes ඇතුJළේ animation එJකේ ආරම්භය, අතරමුද සහ අවසානය define කරනවා. animation-
duration, iteration-count සහ timing-function මගින් run වන හුටි පොලනය කරනවා.
Read the diagram: At 0%, 50%, 100% the same object has different opacity; a new cycle repeats.
0%, 50%, 100% stages වල opacity බලන්න. Reduced motion නම් ස්ථාවරව තබන්න.

Expected result: The indicator fades and returns each second; reduced-motion preference stops
the effect.
Interview question: How is animation different from transition?
Answer: Keyframes can run through multiple stages without a hover or other value change.
